include_human.description: Explicitly include Human-gated execution. Never signs or waives a Human decision; waits for the exact real signature before accepting.

input_schema.description: Authorize 1-32 exact current-plan nodes. Human-gated nodes require include_human=true; this only delegates execution and subsequent acceptance after an actual exact Human signature. Healthy Human waits retain the grant and still notify the manager. Rejection, input, failure, plan/driver/manager changes stop it. Never completes the root. Preserve the original expected_revision, plan_revision_id and control_version.
